gatesUnchanged.rule: every number in the text must exist in the fact set (no model arithmetic; a derived value is engine-pre-computed)
the AI may name ONLY the engine's own verdict word(s); case-insensitive, negation-aware
a comparative binding two fact-set entities over a fact metric must MATCH the fact ordering (fail-closed)
safe/audited/risk-free/guaranteed banned outright; critical/severe only fact-backed
a recommendation shape routes to the ADVICE boundary (X-ADVICE, law)
